visual.name: otifHitCodes
visual.description: Editable reason-code dimension (OTIF flag, descriptions, managed Classification picklist) backed by Cloudflare D1; drives OTIF on refresh

dataRoles.name: currentUser
dataRoles.description: REQUIRED — bind the [Current User] measure (USERPRINCIPALNAME()) here. Editing is admin-only and the admin lookup matches this value against the People roster, so leaving this field well EMPTY makes the whole grid read-only for everyone, including admins. Also used for write attribution and the per-user saved column layout.
